description: Two storey rear extension at first and second floor to enlarge existing  accommodation.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b42b929f-7fff-1b09-dfa6-a0f5f85a508c"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">In the absence of sufficient information to fully assess the impact of the proposal on the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, namely through the submission of a BRE Sunlight and Daylight Report, </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">it can not be adequately demonstrated that the proposal would not harm the amenities of adjoining occupiers.&nbsp; As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies LP1 IDesign Quality and Local Character) and LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021). And the guidance in Hackney's </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009). </span></p>

<p><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed extension, by reason of its size, bulk, design, and location, would result in an incongruous and incompatible form of development which would fail to respect the character and appearance of the subject property and terrace</span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial; vertical-align: baseline;"> of which the application site forms part. As such, the proposal is contrary to policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: Arial; vertical-align: baseline;">and </span><span style="background-color: transparent; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: Arial;">policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) and D4 (Delivering good design) </span><span style="background-color: transparent; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: Arial; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">of the London Pla</span><span style="background-color: transparent; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: Arial; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">n (2021)</span><span style="background-color: transparent; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: Arial; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">, </span><span style="background-color: transparent; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: Arial;">and the guidance contained in Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).</span></p>
